item.title: 13k-Mile 1990 Chevrolet Corvette ZR-1
item.description: This 1990 Chevrolet Corvette ZR-1 remained with its original owner for 17 years before it spent one year with its second owner, and it was purchased in 2008 by the seller, who has added less than 500 of the 13k miles. The car in Bright Red over gray leather and is powered by a 5.7-liter LT5 V8 paired with a ZF six-speed manual transmission. item.title: 2018 Mercedes-Benz E400 Cabriolet at No Reserve
item.description: This 2018 Mercedes-Benz E400 cabriolet was specified in Emerald Green Metallic over Macchiato Beige and Espresso Brown Nappa leather, and it was factory optioned with the AMG Line, Premium 1, and Premium 2 packages. The car was first delivered to Mercedes-Benz of Oakland in California, and it remained in the original owner's care until earlier this year. item.title: 1,800-Mile 2007 Lotus Elise Type 72D
item.description: This 2007 Lotus Elise Type 72D is #20 of 50 examples produced worldwide to commemorate the Lotus 72. It remained with the original owner in Arizona until February 2025, and the seller purchased it the following month and has added 700 of the 1,800 indicated miles. Finished in Starlight Black Metallic with gold accents over black and beige upholstery, the car is powered by a 1.8-liter inline-four paired with a six-speed manual transaxle. item.title: 2024 Mercedes-AMG S63 E Performance Edition 1
item.description: This 2024 Mercedes-AMG S63 E Performance 4MATIC+ plug-in hybrid is an Edition 1 example, which added $13,350 to the price and included unique trim and the AMG Night Package. The sedan is finished in Manufaktur Alpine Grey over Black AMG Exclusive Nappa leather, and the twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V8 and electric motor were rated for a combined output of 791 horsepower and 1,055 lb-ft of torque. item.title: 1988 Airstream Excella 25 at No Reserve
item.description: This 1988 Airstream Excella is a 25-foot tandem-axle travel trailer with a floorplan that features a front lounge/dining area, a middle kitchenette and bath, and a rear bedroom. item.title: 2020 Ford GT Mk II Race Car #001
item.description: This 2020 Ford GT Mk II is the first of 45 track-only Mk II models that were engineered independent of race series regulations and built by Multimatic in Ontario, Canada. Chassis MKII–001 is said to have been driven on track at the Dubai Autodrome, the Silverstone Circuit, and the Bahrain International Circuit between 2020 and 2022. item.title: 35k-Mile 2008 Bentley Continental GTC
item.description: This 2008 Bentley Continental GTC is finished in gray over beige leather and has 35k miles following history in Texas since new. item.title: 32k-Mile 1989 Porsche 911 Turbo Coupe
item.description: This 1989 Porsche 911 Turbo coupe spent time in Puerto Rico before relocating to the mainland United States in 2009, and it now shows 32k miles. Powered by a turbocharged 3.3-liter flat-six paired with a five-speed G50 manual transaxle, the car is finished in Linen Metallic over Linen Gray leather upholstery. item.title: 1965 Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint GT at No Reserve
item.description: This 1965 Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint GT was specified from the factory finished in Bluette over Cuoio Skai vinyl and is believed to have spent time in the UK before being brought to the US at some point under previous ownership. The car is powered by a 1.6L twin-cam inline-four equipped with dual Weber carburetors and linked with a five-speed manual transmission. item.title: 1961 Aston Martin DB4 Series III
item.description: This 1961 Aston Martin DB4 is one of approximately 165 Series III examples built during a single year of production. Chassis 619/R was first registered in May 1961 in Norwich, England, and was purchased in 1969 by an owner who remained its steward for five decades before his passing. The car was then imported to the US and purchased by the seller in 2021.
